page.title: Jogajogko
page.intro: Apeak̕ biḍạu khatao jogao me. Amak̕ ads khon lead do̠ apnar tege My Leads re seṭerok̕ kana, mit̕ lead re kharch ar kharch sãote.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form Ińaḱ Lead re̠ ạḍi jạruṛa, dinạm kharch ar mit́ lead re̠aḱ kharch, ar lead reaḱ gun do̠ LinkedIn ( Conversions API ) re̠ arhõ̠ ko̠ kol ocoḱa.
catalog.notAvailable: Noa server re nit hõ baṅ seṭer akana

banner.connected: LinkedIn jọpọṛao akana. Nit do̠ lead ko hatao̠et́ kana - noa page do̠ mit́ ghạṛić re̠ update hoyoḱ kana.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn do̠ nit hạbić noa se̠rver re̠ baṅ se̠ṭe̠r akana. Mit̕ṭen ạyurić do̠ LinkedIn app reaḱ gạkhuṛ ID ar guṭ katha joṛao jạruṛa.
banner.expired: LinkedIn jogajog do̠ mucạt̕ akana, onate lead do̠ baṅ sync hoyok̕ kana. Lagao lạgit́ arhõ jogajog me.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn lạkti kana je am do arhõ {{date}} hạbic’ sain in lạkti kana . Ona lahare arhõ jogajog me jemon lead ko calao idi.

connect.title: LinkedIn jọpọṛao me̱
connect.intro: LinkedIn khata te̱ sain in me̱ jahã amak’ biggapọn sapṛao et’ kana. Leadrat eken amaḱ biḍạu khatao, Lead Gen Form reaḱ biḍạu ar biḍạu reaḱ sạkhyạt ko paṛhaoet́ kana, ar am switch on reaḱ pherao ko kol ocoet́ kana.
connect.need1: LinkedIn ad khata re mit̕ṭen bhumika (Nạ̃ṛĩ se̠ jạsti).
connect.need2: Link akan company reaḱ sahṭa re mit́ṭen bhumika (Probhu, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Kuraṭor se Bisnạsiạ) - LinkedIn ona do̠ ạḍi jạruṛa lead ko hạṭiń lạgit́.
connect.need3: Apeak̕ Lead Gen Forms re mit̕ṭen phone nombor kukli - begor phone nombor te lead do̠ baṅ joṛao daṛeak̕a.

connection.fetchTitle: Tarik hạṭiń lekate lead hatao me
connection.fetchHint: Nawa lead ko do thora minit re check huyuk kana ar mucạt̕ 7 din do dinke din arhõ check huyuk kana, onate cet̕ hõ̠ baṅ bạgi oṭoak̕ kana. Noa do̠ jogajog laha khon lead lạgit́ beohar me, se̠ arhõ mit́ṭen somoe ńel lạgit́ (mit́ okte re 90 din hạbić). Leadrat re laha kho̠n ge̠ lead ko̠ bạgi o̠co̠aḱ kana.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: LinkedIn lại me̠ ona re̠aḱ oka le̠ḍe̠r do̠ sạri ạidạri ko̠ hoelena. Tinre LinkedIn mit̕ṭen kạmiạko latar re bachao akan sạjại re seṭerok̕ kana, Leadrat LinkedIn re report e̠mdaṛeak̕a , onate amaḱ kạmi reaḱ report do̠ kạmiạkoak̕ gun ko so̠do̠ra ar LinkedIn amaḱ bhage kạmiạko leka arhõ ho̠ṛko ńam daṛeak̕a. Eken LinkedIn reaḱ lead ID ar email reaḱ mit́ ṭen hạṭiń ko kol ocoet́ kana.
